name: Unit 1 Lab Quiz: Wasp Sting/Murder & a Meal (26-27)

description:
Make sure you include all explanations! Check the rubric again!!

You must submit your work as a PDF.

  • Accuracy of Connections 
  • Did I make 5 connections between organelles?
  • Are my connections scientifically correct?
  • Do my organelles actually work together or depend on each other in the way I described?
  • Explanation of Connections
  • Did I explain how the two organelles are connected?
  • Did I give enough detail so someone else could understand the relationship?
  • Did I avoid one-word or vague answers?
  • Complexity & Thoughtfulness
  • Did I go beyond simple facts (ex: not just “they are both in the cell”)?
  • Did I explain the process or the reason they depend on each other (ex., protein synthesis, energy transfer, or waste removal)?
  • Did I show deeper thinking about how the cell works as a system?
  • Completion & Analysis Questions
  • Did I answer all of the analysis questions at the end?
  • Did I check that my answers are accurate?
  • Did I show reflection (not just short/simple answers)?

Teacher Rubric

5 Points

4 Points

2 Points

0-1 Points

Total

Accuracy of Connections

All connections are scientifically accurate and clearly show how the organelles interact or depend on one another.

Most connections are accurate, with only one minor error or unclear link.

Some connections are accurate, but others are vague, incomplete, or incorrect.

Only 1–2 connections show accurate relationships.

Very few or no connections are accurate.

___/5

Explanation of Connections

Each connection is thoroughly explained with clear reasoning, showing strong understanding of cell processes.

Most explanations are clear and logical, but lack some detail.

Some explanations are clear, but others are too brief or lack reasoning.

Explanations are minimal, unclear, or repetitive.

Explanations are missing or do not make sense

___/5

Complexity and Critical Thinking

Connections show higher-level thinking, going beyond surface-level facts to explain how organelles work together in systems (e.g., protein synthesis, energy flow, waste removal).

Connections mostly show good thought, with some deeper connections but also some surface-level ones.

Connections show basic understanding, but few demonstrate deeper thinking.

Connections are mostly simple or obvious, with little attempt at depth.

Very little thought or originality shown.

___/5

Analysis Questions

All analysis questions are complete, accurate, and demonstrate reflection/understanding.

Most questions are complete and accurate, with some minor gaps.

Some questions are incomplete, vague, or have errors.

Only a few questions are answered, with limited accuracy or effort.

Questions not completed.
